title: Pauser can sandwich pause/unpause cycles to selectively deny yield to specific stakers (dual-listed with C-04)
description: The pauser role can pause immediately after a substantial accStablePerShare credit, forcing liquidity-constrained users into pauseWithdraw (which silently forfeits accrued rewards), then unpause for pauser-aligned stakers to claim normally. Listed at QA level here because the root cause is the documented KI-6 pauser trust assumption; the centralization-bundle commentary is the primary venue (C-04).
impact: Pauser-aligned stakers extract disproportionate yield; targeted stakers forced into pauseWithdraw forfeit accrued rewards. No direct fund theft, but value-redistribution against documented operator intent.
attackPath: Pauser observes a substantial accStablePerShare credit pending after collectReward.
Pauser pauses immediately after the credit.
Target user, needing liquidity, calls pauseWithdraw — forfeiting rewards.
Pauser unpauses; pauser-aligned stakers claim normally.
likelihood: depends on pauser acting adversarially or colluding
assumptions: Adversarial / colluding pauser; KI-6 acknowledges pauser trust
recommendation: See C-04. QA-level mitigation: emit Paused(by, reason) / Unpaused(by) events with sufficient context for off-chain anomaly detection and require an unpause-cooldown to dampen the sandwich.
classifierRationale: Root cause IS KI-6 pauser trust. Routes to C bundle as sanitizer predicted.
